remarks: This is the home that will offer you the lifestyle you have been looking for - immaculate/turn key condition, move in ready, great village (Springdale) location, and all the while tucked away on a private cul de sac within the coveted Riverwood Association. This 3 bedroom home has a spacious open concept floorplan. The living room with gas fireplace and dining room with door leads out to a private patio and lawn area. There's a fabulous BRAND NEW kitchen and appliances with pantry and laundry room. A powder room on the main floor as well. Upstairs there are 3 generous bedrooms. The primary has a full bath, walk in closet and an additional closet. The other two bedrooms are filled with sunlight and ample closet too. A hallway full bathroom is here also. An attached one car garage, a private driveway plus visitor parking, gorgeous engineered floors throughout, freshly painted, natural gas heat, central A/C, smart thermostat, private association with low common fees begs the question ....What are you waiting for?
